input.question_for_claimant: Thank you for your claim. The boot model and date code on your label match the recall, but Boot Barn is not one of the retailers named in this recall. Please send proof of ownership, such as a receipt or order record showing the boots were bought from an approved seller (Grainger, Safety Shoes Distributors, Saf-Gard Safety Shoe Company, grainger.com, or justinboots.com), or a note explaining how you came to own the boots (for example, bought secondhand or received as a gift).
